releaseNotes: Adds five contextual Hebrew and Greek word studies (hesed, ruach, nephesh, logos and metanoia), each with passage-specific contextual explanations and interpretive cautions. Adds five original passage commentaries across Leviticus, 1 Samuel, Psalms, Micah and John, with context, observation and safeguards. Refreshes the offline study cache and validates the expanded library against the bundled KJV.
